blind.B1: Not blind: packet A had no paper and no exercise words in any column, and the case folder held no abstract. From packet A alone, nothing in the series suggests an exercise arm. No sequenced sample carries an exercise factor; the series should not be analyzed for an exercise question. Caveat: B was opened before the blind answers were written.
blind.B2: Could not be determined from packet A (no paper). The GEO description, as quoted in packet B, gives patch-seq temperature-responsive Yes n=4 vs No n=3. This is not an exercise comparison.
blind.B3: Packet A lists no candidate pairing key. Each sample is a pool of 2 neurons. No repeated measures are evident.
blind.B4: The paper text was not available to me, so this is unknown. Packet B quotes DESeq2 (Galaxy) as the method, without a joint or pairwise statement.
blind.B5: Not verifiable from packet A. Packet B quotes padj < 0.05 (BH) with no fold-change cutoff, from the Fig 3i legend. I did not check this against the paper.
blind.note: No paper full text was provided, so these answers are limited to packet A and the GEO description.

checks.evidence: Packet A: no exercise words in any column. Packet B: the only factor is temperature responsive Yes/No (4 vs 3), and the paper is about torpor and thermoregulation. Refusal is consistent.
No contrast was run. The TR 4 / NR 3 sample split is recorded as GSM4641593-96 vs GSM4641597-99.
Packet A shows no candidate pairing key. Each sample is a pool of 2 neurons from separate recordings.
No analysis was run. Strain and tissue are constant across samples.
The matrix could not be downloaded (403/550) and was not needed.
The recorded paper rule (padj < 0.05, BH, no fold-change cutoff, Fig 3i legend) is plausible. I could not verify it against the paper text.
No DEG counts are claimed; HANDBACK states none. The paper count is 'not stated (volcano only)'.

'No exercise arm' was checked against the GEO characteristics: temperature responsive Yes/No, strain Esr1-ZsGreen, tissue Brain. The 'physical activity' mentioned in the paper is home-cage telemetry with no RNA-seq. The search covered both the paper and the GEO fields, so it was wide enough.

summary: 该系列是 ERα+ MPA 神经元的 patch-seq(温度响应 Yes 4 / No 3),论文主题为 torpor/体温调节,没有运动组,拒绝(refuse)是合理的。拒绝理由已对照 GEO 特征与论文中"physical activity"(仅笼内遥测、无测序)核实。本次评审没有拿到论文全文,且 packet B 先于盲答打开,因此盲答只基于 packet A 与 GEO 描述,阈值未对照论文原文核实。
